rows.Kwic: No.2076景德傳燈錄序景德傳燈錄序翰林學士朝散大夫行左司諫知制誥同修國史判史館
本來付有法付了言無法各各須自悟悟了無無法阿難付法眼藏竟。
本性本心別無道理。會取會取。

Override.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄, Pizao Duo (the unnamed-by-personal-name 'Fallen Stove-Breaker' master) section. Pizao Duo is the exact speaker who tells the attendant that patriarchs and buddhas only speak as the person, and that original nature and original mind have no separate principle. Lao'an is not the section subject.

rows.Kwic: 見境心不起名不生。不生即不滅。既無生滅即不被前塵所縛。當處解脫。不生名無念。無念即無滅。無念即無縛。無念即無脫。舉要而言。識心即離念。

Override.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄, Baotang Wuzhu section under the heirs of Wuxiang. Baotang Wuzhu is the exact respondent who explains that when mind does not arise upon seeing an object, one is liberated right where one stands (當處解脫). Wuxiang is his lineage teacher, not this passage's speaker.

rows.Kwic: 若於一切處行住坐臥。純一直心不動道場真成淨土。名一行三昧。

Override.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄, Huineng section. Huineng is the exact speaker who defines single-practice samadhi as maintaining a pure, straight mind in every place while walking, standing, sitting, and lying down. Wuxiang is not the actor.

rows.Kwic: 於中夜獨入方丈禮拜哀請。

Override.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄, Xinzhou Zhichang section. Xinzhou Zhichang is the exact autobiographical speaker who tells Huineng that, while seeking instruction from Datong, he entered the abbot's quarters alone at midnight to bow and plead. Wuxiang is not involved.

rows.Kwic: 理明則言語道斷。何言之能議。旨會則心行處滅。何觀之能思。

Override.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄, Yongjia Xuanjue section, in his ten-gate exposition. Yongjia Xuanjue is the exact prose author who says that when the purport is met, the place of mental activity ceases (心行處滅), beyond contemplative thought. Wuxiang is not the author.

rows.Kwic: 藏無對一日喚侍者。侍者應諾。如是三召皆應諾。師曰。將謂吾孤負汝。却是汝孤負吾南泉到參。師問。什麼處來。對曰江西來。師曰。還將得馬師真來否

Override.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄, Nanyang Huizhong section. Nanyang Huizhong's unnamed attendant is the exact actor who responds (應諾) to each of Huizhong's three calls. The line, expanded context, section header, book title, TEI header, and parallel passages never give the attendant a personal name; Wuxiang is not involved.

rows.Kwic: 即指淨瓶問云。不得喚作淨瓶。汝喚作什麼。華林云。不可喚作木𣔻也。百丈不肯。乃問師。師蹋倒淨瓶。

Override.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄, in the Baizhang Huaihai heirs section. Guishan Lingyou is the exact decisive actor who responds to Baizhang's public bottle test by kicking over the pure-water bottle; Baizhang points to and questions about the bottle, then awards Guishan the abbacy.

rows.Kwic: 師過淨瓶與仰山。仰山擬接。師却縮手云。是什麼。

Override.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄, Guishan Lingyou section. Guishan Lingyou is the exact actor who passes the pure-water bottle toward Yangshan Huiji and draws it back when Yangshan reaches for it. Baizhang Huaihai is not the actor in this later exchange.

rows.Kwic: 南泉曰。平常心是道。師曰。還可趣向否。
見露柱師合掌曰。不審世尊。一僧曰。和尚是露柱。

Override.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄, Guangxiao Huijue section. Guangxiao Huijue is the exact actor who sees a pillar, joins his palms, and greets it as World-Honored One; a monk then tells him that he is the pillar. Zhaozhou Congshen is not the section subject.

rows.Kwic: 曰如何是文殊師。師竪拂子示之。僧曰。莫遮箇是麼。

Override.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄, Yangshan Nanta Guangyong section. Nanta Guangyong is the exact actor who raises the whisk when asked who Manjushri's teacher is. Yangshan Huiji is a different master and is not the actor here.

rows.Kwic: 如何是一大事因緣。師曰。

Override.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄, Touzi Datong section. An unnamed monk questioning Touzi Datong is the exact speaker who cites the buddhas appearing for one great matter of causes and conditions, then asks what that great matter is. Touzi answers by naming the official who opened the hall. All six attribution rungs leave the monk unnamed; Cuiwei Wuxue is not the actor.

rows.Kwic: 師後參道吾問。如何是觸目菩提。道吾喚沙彌。沙彌應諾。吾曰。添淨缾水著。吾却問師。汝適來問什麼。師乃舉前問道吾便起去。師從此惺覺。

Override.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄, Shishuang Qingzhu section. Shishuang Qingzhu is the exact questioner who asks Daowu Yuanzhi, ‘what is awakening upon contact with the eyes?’ Daowu calls a novice, sends him to add water to the bottle, and walks away after Shishuang repeats the question.

rows.Kwic: 問如何是聲前一句。師曰吽。曰轉後如何。師曰。是什麼。

Override.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄, Xuanquan Yan section. An unnamed monk questioning Xuanquan Yan is the exact speaker who asks for the phrase before sound; Xuanquan responds with a lowing sound. All six attribution rungs leave the monk personally unnamed; Yantou Quanhuo is not the section subject.

rows.Kwic: 亡僧面前正是觸目菩提。萬里神光頂後相。

Override.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄, Xuansha Shibei section. Xuansha Shibei is the exact teaching-seat speaker who says that directly before a dead monk is precisely awakening upon contact with the eyes. Xuefeng Yicun is Xuansha's lineage teacher, not the speaker here.

rows.Kwic: 有僧問如何是觸目菩提。師踢狗子作聲走。僧無對。師曰。小狗子不消一踢。

Override.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄, Taiyuan Fu section. An unnamed monk questioning Taiyuan Fu is the exact speaker who asks what awakening upon contact with the eyes is; Taiyuan kicks a dog so that it runs off yelping. All six attribution rungs leave the monk unnamed; Xuefeng Yicun is not the actor.

rows.Kwic: 問如何是觸目菩提。師曰。面前佛殿。

Override.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄, Tongan Daopi section. An unnamed monk questioning Tongan Daopi is the exact speaker who asks what awakening upon contact with the eyes is; Tongan answers, ‘the buddha hall before you.’ All six attribution rungs leave the monk personally unnamed; Yunju Daoying is the lineage ancestor, not the actor.

rows.Kwic: 問如何是聲前一句。師曰。恰似不道。

Override.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄, Heyushan Guanghui section. An unnamed monk questioning Heyushan Guanghui is the exact speaker who asks for the phrase before sound; Guanghui answers, ‘it is exactly as if it were not said.’ All six attribution rungs leave the monk personally unnamed; Caoshan Benji is the lineage teacher, not the actor.

rows.Kwic: 是諸佛頂族。汝既承當不得。所以我方便勸汝。

Override.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄, Xuansha Shibei section. Xuansha Shibei is the exact teaching-seat speaker who tells the assembly that because they cannot take it on, he uses expedients to urge them. The full context remains within Xuansha's uninterrupted address; the section heading, book and TEI titles, and parallel contextual checks confirm Xuansha rather than leaving the speaker unnamed.
